title: Andretti Acquisition Corp. II 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: Andretti Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq (tickers: POLE/POLEW/POLEU), amended and restated promissory notes to three insiders on April 27, 2026, increasing aggregate principal from $1.5 million to $4.375 million to fund working capital ahead of a potential business combination.
key_points: Original promissory notes issued October 14, 2025 totaling $1.5 million to William Sandbrook ($720k), Michael Andretti ($300k), and William Brown ($480k).
Amended notes effective April 27, 2026 increase totals to $2.1 million, $875,000, and $1.4 million respectively, for a revised aggregate of $4,375,000.
Notes bear no interest and are due upon business combination completion or company liquidation.
Up to $1.5 million of principal may be converted into SPAC units at $10.00 per Conversion Unit at the Payees' option.
Company is an emerging growth company; IPO presumably completed prior to this filing.
Registration exemption claimed under Section 4(a)(2) of Securities Act of 1933.
